case_name: Jagjit Singh vs Central Bureau Of Investigati

paragraphs.text:
Date : 07-03-2024 This appeal was called on for pronouncement of
 Judgment today.

For Respondent(s) Mrs. Aishwariya Bahti, A.S.G.
 Mr. Mukesh Kumar Maroria, AOR
 Mrs. Shagun Thakur, Adv.
 Mrs. Shreya Jain, Adv.
 Mr. Prakash Gautam, Adv.

UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R
1 Hon'ble Mr Justice J B Pardiwala pronounced the judgment of the Bench
 comprising His Lordship and Hon'ble Mr Justice Manoj Misra.
2 The Criminal Appeal is disposed of in terms of the signed reportable
 judgment.
3 Pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
(CHETAN KUMAR) (SAROJ KUMARI GAUR)
 A.R.-cum-P.S. Assistant Registrar
